summary: Expose composable mission step rows and progress meters through the optional-ratatui fractal-mission-ui crate, preserving terminal UI output.

replay.detail: Presentation extraction only; no claim replay or projection rebuild changes.

schema.detail: No database, schema, index, or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade requirements change.

compatibility.detail: No client or wire protocol changes. The terminal UI retains its step expansion keys and rendering; embedding applications may opt into the new Rust crate.

downtime.detail: No additional restart or service interruption is required by this presentation-only extraction.

manual.detail: Existing installations need no configuration or state changes.

recovery.detail: No stored-state transition or additional recovery procedure is introduced.
